prompt:
Fix snippets/store-locator-entry.liquid, which renders one result in the store locator list. Inputs (top-level variables; nothing is under section.settings): - store: object (never null) with these keys, always present: - store.name: string (not null). - store.address_lines: array of strings (may be empty; individual strings may be empty or whitespace-only). - store.phone: string or null. - store.distance_m: integer >= 0, or null. - store.hours: array (may be empty) of objects, each with keys day (string), open (string or null), close (string or null). - store.is_selected: boolean. - today: string (not null), a day name such as "Tuesday". Output, in this order, on a single line with no whitespace between elements: 1.
or, when store.is_selected is true,
2.

{name}

with the name HTML-escaped. 3. Address: strip leading and trailing whitespace from each address line, drop lines that become empty, and join the remaining lines in their original order with ", " (comma and space). If at least one line remains, output

{joined}

with the joined text HTML-escaped. Otherwise output nothing for the address. 4. Distance, only when store.distance_m is not null:

{text}

where text is: - below 1000: "{m} m" (for example "999 m", "0 m"); - from 1000 up to and including 9999: kilometres with exactly one decimal, truncated rather than rounded: "{m div 1000}.{(m mod 1000) div 100} km" (1250 gives "1.2 km", 1999 gives "1.9 km", 1000 gives "1.0 km"); - 10000 or more: whole kilometres, truncated: "{m div 1000} km" (25780 gives "25 km"). 5. Hours: find the first entry in store.hours whose day equals today, compared case-insensitively. Only the first matching entry is used. If there is no match, output nothing. If the matching entry's open or close is null, output

Closed today

. Otherwise output

Open today {open}-{close}

with open and close HTML-escaped. The separator is a plain hyphen with no spaces around it. 6. Phone: strip leading and trailing whitespace from store.phone. Treat null as empty. If the result is non-empty, output {phone}. phone is the stripped value, HTML-escaped. tel is the stripped value with every space, hyphen, opening parenthesis, closing parenthesis and period removed. All other characters, including +, are kept. 7.
Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/store-locator-entry.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
